title: DPAPI master keys
whyItMatters: These per-user keys unlock protected passwords, cookies and Wi-Fi secrets. Their presence shows which protected secrets the account could recover.
notes: Contains per-SID folders with GUID master-key files plus CREDHIST and Preferred. Machine keys under System32/Microsoft/Protect are not covered here.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the apps and browser profiles that store protected secrets on this PC before removing the keys.
steps: Remove the saved credentials, cookies and passwords that use these keys first.
Do not delete the folder named in the plan by hand: Windows needs it to read your saved secrets, and the full reset at the end removes it.
cleanup.risk: Deleting these keys by hand can lock you out of saved passwords, Wi-Fi keys and encrypted files on this account.
